name: The Alchemist's Science Lab
provenance: Original SVG illustrations authored for Recall Rally. No third-party images, fonts, runtime dependencies or external asset requests.

assets.role: Layered stone-and-copper laboratory room, without UI or characters
Recurring professor with normal and surprised expression groups
Original engraved brass/copper chassis, glass routes, gauges, wood-inlaid pedestal; dynamic potion layers inserted at build/runtime
Potion-only illustration of the established Fizzwick design, with curious/excited/startled/celebrating expression layers
Original carved oak cabinet, engraved brass chassis and circuit guides; dynamic battery, switch, lamp, wiring and ammeter layers inserted at runtime
Original engraved copper and brass botanical glass-chamber chassis, scientific instruments, Petri dish and field notebook; layered live Moonwing and habitat controls inserted at runtime
Original engraved brass/copper observatory equipment chassis; dynamic state-dependent instrument, glass and sky layers inserted at runtime

interactive_art: src/science-lab.js renders five distinct SVG machines from actual experiment steps. The existing renderGameHero supplies the customized player. Assets and machines are embedded in index.html and the standalone build. PotionMixerArt in src/science-lab-potion.js builds five distinct clipped glass vessels, progress-dependent liquid/drive states and bounded transition effects. CircuitConstructorArt in src/science-lab-circuit.js adds five assembly actions, an open-switch repair state and closed-loop illumination. CreatureIncubatorArt in src/science-lab-creature.js adds five habitat controls and an expressive fictional Moonwing, with pre-reveal movement, confetti sneeze and persistent repair targets. Weather and the original professor asset are unchanged. StarObservatoryArt in src/science-lab-observatory.js renders five independently repaired controls, scientific/fictional distinctions, mistake recovery and the final sky display.
motion: CSS-only equipment and character reactions, disabled by prefers-reduced-motion; no new frame loop or external animation library.
